name: Traverse the Secret Skills Cave tutorial loop and return to its start
dungeon_reset_exception: After leaving any room in Secret Skills Cave, do not reset: the previous room then becomes unreachable.
room_source: Live WRAM bounds identify candidates. Overlapping coordinate ranges are resolved from the prior room and the directed room graph. Curated image coordinates are not globally identical to WRAM coordinates.
cave_visual_rules: A red wall sprite may be a torch and is not evidence of a door or NPC.
In this cave, door fronts use the threshold/arrow anchor and only traverse north-south.
In this cave, every small door-transit room uses the same layout: two live tiles left and two live tiles right of the aligned arrival column.

rooms.objective: Use the north door to begin; on the return leg reach the original start position.
rooms.success_evidence: The loop is complete only after all rooms were visited and WRAM is again near (28,55).

rooms.objective: Traverse the simple north-south room; visible encounters may be unavoidable.
rooms.success_evidence: Forward: enter room 3. Return: enter room 1.

entry_verification.authority: Live Mesen capture 2026-08-09: [28,32] is still the room-2 threshold; [28,31] is the first stable room-3 feet tile

rooms.objective: On the forward leg shoot the distant switch, cross the completed bridge and take the west door. On the return leg continue south to room 2.
rooms.success_evidence: Forward bridge traversal is proven by movement; the cave loop later re-enters this room from room 8.

success_effect.message: The Arrow changed the remote bridge tiles west and south-west of the firing position. The switch succeeded; navigate to the affected bridge instead of shooting again.

entry_verification.authority: Live Mesen capture room4_entry_reference: first controllable tile of the pillar room

rooms.objective: Move the visible pillar itself onto the separate floor button in the middle of the brick floor, then leave through the door that opens. Guy is only the pusher and must never step onto the button as a test or substitute weight.
rooms.success_evidence: The pillar itself visibly occupies the separate floor button and the north door stays passable. Guy must remain off the button; proximity or one intermediate push is not success.

reset_policy.use_when: The pillar was moved into an arrangement from which it can no longer be reached or pushed onto the floor switch, and the current image agrees with the failed probes.
reset_policy.do_not_use_when: Do not reset merely because navigation is uncertain, movement met a wall, or the north door is already open. Secret Skills Cave exception: after leaving a room, never reset because returning to the previous room then becomes impossible.

entry_verification.authority: Live Mesen capture 2026-08-09: [6,17] is the room-4 door threshold; [6,14] is the room-5 entry point

rooms.objective: Use either confirmed eastward drop to reach the lower level, climb the ladder, then follow the measured U-shaped transit into room 6.
rooms.success_evidence: The actor reaches the upper route and enters room 6.
elevation_rules: Arrow ledges descend only: [7,9] lands at [8,11], while [7,10] lands at [8,12].
The ladder is bidirectional between lower foot [13,12] and upper top [13,10].

entry_verification.authority: Live Mesen capture 2026-08-09: first stable controllable room-6 tile after transit exit [19,6]

rooms.objective: Defeat both mandatory encounters. Green first is the shorter route; descend to the channel, climb AO12 on the right, defeat red and leave east.
rooms.success_evidence: Both green and red encounters are defeated and the right door becomes reachable.
elevation_rules: The left and right walkable areas are raised above the central channel.
Arrow ledges descend; they cannot be climbed in reverse.
The ladder beginning at curated AO12 connects the channel to the right elevation.

rooms.objective: If the boss crown shows it is already defeated, cut only the shortest necessary bush path. Expose and step on the switch in the center of the pale brick patch.
rooms.success_evidence: The blue switch is exposed/occupied and the south door is visibly open.

rooms.objective: Place the upper vase on the right switch to open the center wall, retrieve the lower vase, place it on the left switch, then use the west exit and follow the loop back to room 3.
rooms.success_evidence: Both vases occupy the switches, the west door is open, and room 3 is re-entered.
